messages.check.title: Report artifact verification
messages.check.usage: Usage: report_check.py report.html [--script script.md] [--record record.json] [--locale zh-CN|en] [--json]
messages.check.item.script.pages: Script pages match the report one-to-one
messages.check.item.record.freshness: Verification record matches the current artifacts
messages.check.item.record.pageRefs: Pages referenced by the record exist in the report
messages.check.item.record.calculations: Declared calculations reproduce from their inputs
messages.check.item.record.checks: Record check set is complete and recognizable
messages.check.coverage.label: Content and visual verification coverage (from the record; not run is never shown as passed)
messages.check.coverage.partial: Partially run ({done}/{total} passed; rest failed or not run)
messages.check.coverage.not_run: Not run (no passed result declared in the record)
messages.check.coverage.unverified: Unverified (the record does not match the current artifacts or is invalid)
messages.check.record.stale: matches an older version; its conclusions are not reused
messages.check.deliverable.yes: Deliverable: yes (the record's declaration is consistent with program review; this verdict covers only the artifacts checked here)
messages.check.reason.recordMissing: No usable verification record; content and visual verification were not run
messages.check.reason.stale: The verification record matches an older version and cannot back the current artifacts
messages.check.reason.declaredNo: The record itself does not declare the report deliverable
messages.check.reason.recordChecks: The record's check set is incomplete or contains unrecognized checks
messages.check.next: Next: run the content and visual checks not yet executed, update the record, then re-run this check; the draft can go straight into the review page.
messages.check.next.blocked: Next: resolve the structural problems above before review.
messages.check.err.recordBadType: Record fields have the wrong type: {fields}
messages.check.err.pageMissing: Pages referenced by the record are missing from the report: {keys}
messages.check.err.stale: Record does not match the current artifacts; these files changed: {items}
messages.check.err.calcMismatch: {claim}: recomputing from the declared inputs gives {actual}, the record declares {expected}
messages.check.err.calcBad: {claim}: the calculation declaration cannot be recomputed ({reason})
messages.check.err.checksEmpty: The record has no usable check results: content and visual checks must each be declared item by item ({reason})
messages.check.err.checkUnknown: The record declares checks this tool does not recognize: {ids}; their execution cannot be proven
messages.check.err.checkStatus: {id} has status {status}, which is not valid (pass / fail / not_run / unavailable)
messages.check.err.scriptMismatch: Script pages do not match the report: {detail}
messages.check.warn.derivedKeys: Page keys are derived from page numbers ({keys}); annotations cannot be re-anchored after reordering. Use stable, unique semantic keys (e.g. data-key="sum")
messages.check.err.noPages: The report has no page sections (class containing page with data-page)
messages.check.err.sourceStatus: {entry} has no recognizable reading status {status} (status is read / partial / unreadable)
messages.check.err.sourceField: {entry} has an incomplete reading disclosure: missing {fields} (partial must state the range actually read and the unread part; unreadable must state why)
messages.check.err.readingBlocked: All substantive materials ({n}) are unreadable: an empty shell or fabricated content does not count as a completed draft
messages.check.reason.readingBlocked: All substantive materials are unreadable: draft generation cannot be declared complete
